approval_boundary: Rat/scattered/alligator crawling concept approved; attacks, HP, thresholds, timing and terminal defeat design provisional. Runtime integration not authorized. Cue durations never drive gameplay timers.

event_contract.encounter_start: Start formed bed once; never per-roach voices.
event_contract.transform_collapse: Collapse cue once; crossfade formed to dispersed. Never death.
event_contract.transform_reform: Reform cue once; crossfade dispersed to formed.
event_contract.hit: Positive actual nonlethal HP reduction only; .12s actor-local simulation-time cooldown. Proposed threshold-crossing collapse replaces simultaneous hit.
event_contract.terminal_death: Guard exactly once on actual terminal defeat; stop all other cues/beds, let death tail finish. Never on phase transition/despawn/restore.
event_contract.priority: terminal death > attack warning > phase cue > hit > bed

limits.rapid_transition: Retarget existing two players from current gains; never allocate more.
limits.obsolete_warning: Cancel on phase change/death; never gate attacks on cue completion.

lifecycle.controls: Master/SFX mute applies; music-only mute independent. No queued catch-up events on unmute.
lifecycle.pause: Freeze stream positions, crossfade/duck envelopes and cooldowns.
lifecycle.cleanup: Reset/checkpoint/menu/dispose stops all and clears state; restore never replays prior events.
lifecycle.offscreen: PROPOSED positional attenuation, no offscreen attack initiation; already-fired cues may finish attenuated. Exact distance/culling pending.

validation.source: PASS eight deterministic renders, PCM16 mono44100 headers/frame counts/hashes, peak bounds, one-shot zero edges, loop seam steps108/44 below internal2109/1814; Python syntax120column hygiene.
validation.listening: Not auditioned; perceived seamlessness and mix unapproved.

consultation.Art: StableID confirmed; chitin/legs/antennae, no animal flesh.
consultation.Mechanics: Phase/attack timings and sharedHP candidate only; no per-roach voices.
consultation.Storyboarding: Nonverbal material texture; no animal voice, new origin, intelligence or allegiance.
